title: Problem role-play cards
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Local area, holiday and travel: travel and holidays (2.2, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: problem role-play cards)
intro: Lesson 21: Asking for help and dealing with problems. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Asking politely
points: مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تُسَاعِدَنِي؟

arabic.text:
- مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، عِنْدِي مُشْكِلَةٌ فِي غُرْفَتِي.
- مَا المُشْكِلَةُ؟
- المُكَيِّفُ مَكْسُورٌ، وَالجَوُّ حَارٌّ جِدًّا.
- آسِفٌ، سَنُعْطِيكَ غُرْفَةً أُخْرَى الآنَ.

cards:
هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ ...؟
hal yumkinuka
can you ...?
blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.

panels.title: Card 1: at the airport information desk
points: ! Answer the question you are asked

panels.title: Card 2: at the station
points: ? Ask when the next train is
! Answer the question you are asked

panels.title: Card 3: at the hotel reception
points: ! Answer the question you are asked

blocks.text: The teacher plays the hotel, station or airport worker and asks the unexpected question (!).

box.title: Write one role play in full (8 lines)

blocks.answers: Card 1: at the airport information desk: فَقَدْتُ جَوَازَ سَفَرِي. / فَقَدْتُهُ فِي المَطَارِ، قُرْبَ المَقْهَى. / مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تُسَاعِدَنِي؟ / (مَتَى وَصَلْتَ؟) وَصَلْتُ صَبَاحَ اليَوْمِ. Card 2: at the station: القِطَارُ مُتَأَخِّرٌ. / أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَافِرَ إِلَى لَنْدَنَ. / مَتَى القِطَارُ القَادِمُ؟ / (لِمَاذَا تُسَافِرُ؟) أُسَافِرُ لِزِيَارَةِ جَدَّتِي. Card 3: at the hotel reception: غُرْفَتِي رَقْمُ عِشْرِينَ. / الغُرْفَةُ غَيْرُ نَظِيفَةٍ. / هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي غُرْفَةً أُخْرَى؟ / (كَمْ لَيْلَةً سَتَبْقَى؟) سَأَبْقَى ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ.

questions.q: Explain: I lost my bag at the station; can you help me?
questions.a: فَقَدْتُ حَقِيبَتِي فِي المَحَطَّةِ، هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تُسَاعِدَنِي؟

questions.q: Three role-play cards (our own) in breakout pairs: lost passport, late train, dirty room. Perform each, then write one in full (8 lines) in the portal response box.
questions.a: Problems explained, solutions offered, polite language

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer

questions.q: What is the solution in the role play?
questions.a: A) Another room. سَنُعْطِيكَ غُرْفَةً أُخْرَى.
